interpretation: Idle synthetic SELECT 1 benchmark in db-route-results-review1.json showed route overhead for one Docker control process (host-published p50~3.76ms/p95~10.71ms vs direct-bridge p50~0.70ms/p95~1.94ms) with zero changes to driver, image, credentials, or options. This proves idle route network stack overhead only; it does NOT prove the full 158-query cost in the switching window, does NOT prove PostgreSQL SCRAM authentication stall, and does NOT prove RTP media delay root cause. This proposal delivers an isolated gateway placement diagnostic fixture to evaluate direct bridge database routing as a single variable during genuine SFU signaling without altering application authority, locking, or test assertions.
